The independent exact checker verified 100553 comparisons; finite computations are not substituted for asymptotic proof.

value.rationale: The natural uniform endpoint norm of the first Johnson spectral projector has a sharp worst-case stability constant when the slice cardinality varies. The optimizer lies at a singular thin-slice width sqrt(n/2), not a balanced width; the strict gap sqrt(2/e)>sqrt(2/pi), rigorous three-scale classification, and unique localized extremum make the result a meaningful structural classification rather than a tabulated finite MAD identity. This precise invariant controls maximal bounded-input amplification of degree-one Johnson harmonic filtering.
